claim_boundary: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION fixed-speed, one-lane tap playback with retained fly weights; no within-map learning, other lanes or holds
engineering_assumption: ENGINEERING ASSUMPTION: after each blank-to-visible transition, rearm the fixed readout only after a KC spike from the newly visible cue. Preserve one neural simulator and all fly weights continuously across the map. The cue-local rearm rule passed the frozen task-free probe before this game run.
limitations: Three separated taps only. This is continuous neural playback, not training inside a map, four-key play, chords, holds or live osu!lazer.
primary_gate: Learned arm: exactly three first DOWNs, one per note, all within ±73500us; exactly three UPs, no extras; all three headless tap judgements Good-or-better; one neural initialization and three cue-local readout rearms; exact two-run replay. Matched initial weights: no DOWN and three MISS. Weights immutable throughout playback. Feedback labels delivered only when available.
weight_selection: Use the first completed seed in the predeclared fixed-speed list (907), before observing this three-note map. Keep its final retained weights fixed. Matched initial weights from the same receipt are the no-learning control.
